topics.title: Music and Art in My Life
topics.description: Talk about the role of music and art in your life.
topics.prompt: What kind of music do you like? Do you enjoy visiting art exhibitions? How can music and art make our lives better?
topics.sample_answer: Music and art are important in my life. I enjoy listening to pop music because it helps me relax. I also like looking at paintings because they are beautiful and creative. I sometimes visit art exhibitions with my friends. I think music and art make our lives more interesting.

topics.title: Food Around the World
topics.description: Talk about food and different eating habits around the world.
topics.prompt: What is your favourite Vietnamese dish? What food from another country would you like to try? Why is it interesting to learn about food in different cultures?
topics.sample_answer: My favourite Vietnamese dish is pho. It is made with rice noodles, meat and a delicious soup. I would also like to try sushi from Japan because it looks interesting. I think food is an important part of every culture. Trying different dishes helps us understand other countries and their traditions.

topics.title: The School I Would Like to Visit
topics.description: Talk about a school you would like to visit and its facilities.
topics.prompt: Which school would you like to visit? What facilities would you like to see? What activities would you like to join? What could you learn from the visit?
topics.sample_answer: I would like to visit a modern school with good learning facilities. I want to see its library, science laboratory and computer rooms. I would also like to join some activities with students there. I think visiting another school would be an interesting experience. I could learn new things and make new friends.
